launcher.intro: What Landscape Fixer is allowed to touch: only meshes inside a landscape folder, plus the vertex color clean-up of the terrain and of its meshes. The Blend and Snow tabs hold the options of each pass; everything is written to one plugin, and PG Patcher is left to do the PBR conversion afterwards.

landscapeVertexColors.label: Landscape Vertex Colors
landscapeVertexColors.help: Clears baked-in vertex color tinting on terrain (LAND) records, so they render standalone instead of carrying leftover color grading meant for a different look.
landscapeVertexColors.snow: Clear only where a snow-classified texture is used

meshVertexColors.label: Mesh Vertex Colors
meshVertexColors.help: Clears baked-in vertex color tinting on landscape-folder meshes (rocks, cliffs, icebergs, ...), including DLC variants under DLC01\Landscape\, DLC02\Landscape\, etc.
meshVertexColors.snowOnly: Only on the generated snow meshes

collisionMaterial.label: Collision Material (Footstep Sounds)
collisionMaterial.help: Remaps collision materials on the generated snow meshes toward their snow equivalent (currently just Dirt/Grass -> Snow) so footstep sounds match the snowy visual. Works per collision chunk, so unrelated materials in the same mesh are left alone.
collisionMaterial.snowOnly: Apply on the generated snow meshes

meshBlacklist.label: Snow Mesh Blacklist
meshBlacklist.help: Meshes matching a rule here are never copied by the snow pass. Wildcards (*) allowed, e.g. "*\trees\*". Right click to add/remove rows.

editorIdKeywords.label: Snow EditorID Blacklist Keywords
editorIdKeywords.help: Records whose EditorID contains one of these words (case-insensitive) are skipped by the snow pass - useful for excluding false-positive matches. Right click to add/remove rows.

hideDecalShapes.label: Hide Decal Shapes
hideDecalShapes.help: Avoids z-fighting with Skyrim's own decal-based dynamic snow shaders by hiding any shape textured with "Rocks01"/"SnowRocks01", on mountain/rock/tundra meshes only. Hides the shape instead of deleting it, so no plugin changes are needed. Does not affect DirtCliffs meshes.

removeIceSnowMaterial.label: Ice Snow Material
removeIceSnowMaterial.checkbox: Remove the glacier snow material from statics
removeIceSnowMaterial.help: Clears the SnowMaterialGlacier / SnowMaterialGlacierSlab Material Object from every static that uses it, so no snow is projected on glaciers and ice. Only changes LandscapeFixer.esp - no mesh is modified, and the ice's own shader material is left alone.

scope.label: Landscape Scope
scope.restrict: Only process meshes inside a landscape folder
scope.help: Any mesh whose path has a "landscape" folder (Meshes\Landscape, Meshes\DLC01\Landscape, Meshes\_ResourcePack\Landscape, ...) is in scope. Terrain bases, campfires and other meshes outside those folders are skipped unless they match a pattern below.

meshAddList.label: Additional Meshes
meshAddList.help: Meshes outside a landscape folder to process anyway. Wildcards (*) allowed, e.g. "*\whiterun\wrterrain\*". Right click to add/remove rows.

blend.intro: The blend pass flips alpha test to alpha blend on landscape meshes whose textures have a statics/blend sibling, in place at the mesh's own path, and gives the records that show such a texture a derived TextureSet. Textures without a sibling can get one generated automatically.

blendMeshBlacklist.label: Blend Mesh Blacklist
blendMeshBlacklist.help: Meshes matching a rule here are never patched by the blend pass (ice, roads, trees, ...). Wildcards (*) allowed. Right click to add/remove rows.

blendEditorIdKeywords.label: Blend EditorID Blacklist Keywords
blendEditorIdKeywords.help: Records whose EditorID contains one of these words (case-insensitive) are never touched by the blend pass. Right click to add/remove rows.

generatePbrSlots.label: Generate PBR slots
generatePbrSlots.help: Needed when a PBR texture pack is installed: generates the PBR version of each blend texture and the json PG Patcher uses to convert it. Left off, the blend areas show the low-resolution vanilla texture.
generatePbrSlots.leNote: Not available on Legendary Edition (PBR needs Skyrim Special Edition and Community Shaders).

autoGenerateAllowlist.label: Auto-Generate Allowlist
autoGenerateAllowlist.help: Only these source diffuse textures (relative to Data, e.g. "textures\landscape\dirt01.dds") get a missing statics sibling synthesized automatically. Wildcards (*) allowed. Right click to add/remove rows.
